title: Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2024 — G.S.R. 403(E)

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
content.citation: G.S.R. 403(E), 15 July 2024, Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2024
content.verificationStatus: Official MCA-hosted notification text retrieved and scope checked
content.note: The retrieved MCA-hosted notification identifies G.S.R. 403(E), dated 15 July 2024, and substitutes Form MGT-6 in the Annexure to the Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014. The operative amendment shown in the retrieved text is form-only; it does not amend Rule 17 or Rule 18. This is limited-scope evidence for the amendment chain, not proof of the complete consolidated text or absence of other amendments. The official Gazette PDF for G.S.R. 358(E), 30 May 2025, remains independently unretrieved in this pass; secondary descriptions of that 2025 instrument concern Annexure Forms MGT-7, MGT-7A and MGT-15. Do not treat this source as verification of current Rule 18.
